title: Reproducibility supplement for: Reference-Calibrated Verification of Metamodel Design Jacobians under Finite Simulation Budgets
description: Authoritative SIMPAT revision package in simpat_revision/: frozen external-member gradients, numerical verification for 3,580 reference-gradient components, repeated calibration and training audits, tie and ensemble-size sensitivity, finite reference-budget accounting, matched-cost multistep optimization, openEMS step-ladder provenance, and deterministic figure sources. The matched-cost audit is reported as a boundary result: no deployable score ordering dominates random allocation across all tested outcomes. Antenna derivatives remain numerically unresolved and are excluded from quantitative reliability claims. The project-specific device PINN training framework is not bundled.
